subject: Webinar signup: Request demo — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@acme.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in a demo — webinar registration

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the great webinar this morning — the latency/cost case study was really helpful. I filled out the demo request form and wanted to follow up directly.

We're evaluating options for inference across multi-region deployments and would love a 30-45 minute demo to see Redwood in action and discuss pricing/latency expectations.

My availability next week: Tue 3/10 after 1pm PT, Wed 3/11 morning, or Fri 3/13 between 9-11am PT. If you have a Calendly link I can grab a time.

Best,
Sam Peterson
Senior Platform Engineer — Acme Corp
sam.peterson@acme.io
(415) 555-0182

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@acme.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo — webinar registration

Hi Sam — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for joining the webinar!

I'm Marissa on the SDR team — I can get a demo scheduled with one of our AEs. Quick Q so we make the demo most useful: is your priority to validate latency SLAs for external users, or is cost-per-token and batch throughput the primary concern?

I have the following options with our AE, Lauren:
- Tue 3/10 1:30pm PT / 2:00pm PT
- Wed 3/11 9:00am PT
- Fri 3/13 9:30am PT

If those don't work, here's a quick booking link: https://redwood.in/+demo-booking

I've attached a short product deck so you can scan features before the demo.

Attachment: redwood-product-deck.pdf (PDF, 2MB)

Thanks and speak soon,
Marissa Cole
SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Schedule: https://redwood.in/+demo-booking

From: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@acme.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Corp - Sales Ops <salesops@acme.io>
Date: 2026-03-08T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo — webinar registration

Thanks Marissa — quick answer: primary goal is validating latency SLAs across regions (EU + US), but we also need to understand the cost implications for a steady production load.

On the times above, Tue 3/10 at 1:30pm PT would work best for me. If possible we'd prefer an overview + live demo focused on region routing and caching behaviors.

One more ask — can you include any notes about integrations with our existing logging/Kafka stack? I'll loop in our Sales Ops person (cc'd) to help with procurement logistics.

Best,
Sam

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@acme.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo — webinar registration

Hi Sam — thanks for the note and for sharing your priorities. I'm Lauren (AE) and will run the demo. 1:30pm PT on Tue 3/10 works — I've sent a calendar invite and included a short agenda below. Let me know if you want to add folks from infra/security.

Agenda (30-40 min):
- 5 min intros and goals
- 10-15 min demo: multi-region routing + caching + quantization profiles
- 10 min: integration/ops Q&A (logging/Kafka, KMS)
- 5 min: next steps (pricing/PO process)

Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (ICal event)
Attachment: redwood-product-deck.pdf (PDF, 2MB)

See you Tue — invite shows as 1:30-2:10pm PT.

—Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Book time: https://redwood.in/+demo-booking

From: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@acme.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Acme Corp - Sales Ops <salesops@acme.io>
Date: 2026-03-08T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo — webinar registration

Perfect — thanks Lauren, Marissa. I accepted the invite. Looking forward to the walkthrough and we'll have one engineer from infra + our procurement contact on the call.

Also, if you can drop a one-page note on Kafka/logging integration before then, that'd be super helpful for our infra lead.

See you Tue.

Sam
